schema.title: Verifiable Credential
schema.description: W3C Verifiable Credential issued by dVE for approved verification results. Maps to O-DEF object class 13.1 Service.Verification-Service. Part of Phase 4 Hedera Guardian VC/DID integration.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.

credential_id.description: Unique identifier for the verifiable credential (W3C VC id). O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_1

session_id.description: Reference to the verification session that produced this credential. O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_1.3

entity_id.description: Reference to the verified entity (emission statement, product footprint). O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_1.3

subject_did.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier of the credential subject. O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_3

issuer_did.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier of the credential issuer (dVE). O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_3

status.description: Credential lifecycle status (Draft, Issued, Active, Suspended, Revoked, Expired). O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_3.2

schema_id.description: Reference to the credential schema definition. O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_1.2

proof_value.description: Cryptographic proof value (JSON-LD proof object). O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_14

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the credential was issued. O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_11.1

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the credential expires. O-DEF: ofp-sustainability:13.1_11.2
